_help: Application registry for the NIBL portal cards. Add one object per application. The portal re-reads this file automatically; no restart is needed. Fields: id, name, subtitle, description, icon, order, status (active | coming_soon | hidden), launch.url (where the card opens), launch.token_param (optional: the portal access token is passed in the URL hash under this name), backend.base_url plus provision_path / access_path / validate_path (see shared/documentation/ARCHITECTURE.md, section 'Application contract').
